notes: My own solve: at constant temperature for a fixed mass, PV = C. Taking natural logarithms, ln P + ln V = ln C, so ln P = ln C - ln V. With ln V on the x-axis and ln P on the y-axis the coefficient of x is -1, so the slope is -1, option 2. Every printed line follows from the one above it. common_mistakes[0] points at option 1 (+1), the sign slip, and common_mistakes[1] points at option 3 (zero): at constant pressure ln P would be a constant and the line flat, which is a real confusion between the isothermal and isobaric conditions, so it is a genuine error on this question and not a generic warning.
